# Japan Research Office

> Primary-source research for business decisions. Japan is a core specialization; broader official and public primary-source coverage is used when the defined business question requires it.

Official website: https://japanresearchoffice.com
Contact: hiroaki@japanresearchoffice.com
Operator: Hiroaki Tsuboi, Japan
Communication: Email only

## Service architecture

- Japan Intelligence: https://japanresearchoffice.com/services.html
  Research on Japanese companies, suppliers, markets, products, facilities and commercial developments, including direct research of Japanese-language primary sources.
- Evidence Checks: https://japanresearchoffice.com/services.html
  Defined-scope research around a concrete claim, entity, facility, product, standard, certification, failure, transaction, regulatory issue or document.
- Commercial Change Intelligence: https://japanresearchoffice.com/services.html
  Evidence-led research into commercially relevant state changes, focused on what changed, what primary evidence confirms and what remains unknown.

## Evidence discipline

Client-facing research separates Confirmed Facts, Supported Inferences and Unknowns. A signal is not treated as proof of a downstream commercial event unless the evidence establishes that event. JRO provides evidence and analysis, not final legal, engineering, compliance, procurement, financial or other professional decisions.
